name: Aaron Bollinger
bio: Aaron builds and maintains the research systems behind BestInsurance Research: the source registry, the content model, the retrieval layer, and the checks that stop an unsupported claim from publishing. He drafts questions and coverage pages against primary sources and maps every material claim to the record that carries it.
scope: Drafts questions, coverage pages, entity records, and state pages.
Maintains the source registry and the claim-to-source mapping.
Owns the build-time checks for citation resolution, canonical URLs, and structured data.
Does not sign off on the insurance substance of a page. That is the reviewer's function.
